描述_EN: when acquired this panel was described as a mat; however this panel may have been used as a wall hanging or served another decorative purpose. the silk embroidery consists of satin, stem, long and short, and split stitches. there is an outer band of blue silk to which is sewn a blue silk fringe. circular silk panel. a dragon chasing the jewel amid cloud forms is embroidered in bright colours on grey silk.
